battles.battle_5_requires: nemesis randomizers with a Battle 5 back (Beyond the Breach or later)

steps.text: Separate treasure cards by level into decks, shuffle each and place facedown (levels 1-3; also level 4 if playing Battle 5).
Shuffle the gem, relic and spell randomizer decks separately. Draw 3 gems, 2 relics and 4 spells and add those player cards to the Barracks.
Shuffle the mage randomizers and draw 4; add those mages to the Barracks. Redraw any you do not own.
Divide the nemesis randomizers into one deck per battle according to their card backs (Battle 1-4, plus Battle 5). Shuffle each facedown.
Set the Upgraded Basic nemesis cards aside (they say 'Upgraded Basic' at the bottom).
Optionally (Outcasts) play with Xaxos: Outcast instead of Gravehold for the whole expedition.

expedition_setup.barracks: The Barracks stores everything available in the current expedition: player cards, mats, treasures, nemesis basic and upgraded basic cards.

steps: Each player chooses a mage from the Barracks and sets up its mat as usual.
Build a supply of 9 player cards (3 gems, 2 relics, 4 spells) from the Barracks. Banish every Barracks player card not used in this supply. (Battle 1 has exactly 9.)
Set up treasures according to the battle (see treasure_setup).
player_setup_per_battle.reset_between_games: Everything resets between games except banished cards and anything an expedition specifies: destroyed cards and breaches, starting hands, charges.

1.usage: personal, goes into the starting deck
1.gem_rule: Replace a Crystal in your starting deck if able; otherwise replace any card.
1.spell_rule: Replace a Spark in your starting deck if able; otherwise replace any card.
1.legacy_rule: In The New Age and Outcasts printings: replace a Spark if no Crystal (gem) / a Crystal if no Spark (spell).

2.usage: group treasure; any player may use it; only one in play unless it says otherwise

3.usage: personal, placed on your player mat; only its owner may use it
3.legacy_equipment: A Legacy mage may use one of their equipment effects instead of a level 3 treasure.

4.usage: personal, tucked under your player mat; gain it during your turn by paying its cost, like a supply card

nemesis_setup_per_battle.draw: Draw a nemesis randomizer from the deck matching the current battle. Redraw if you do not own it.
nemesis_setup_per_battle.battle_5: Also follow the extra rules on the Battle 5 randomizer (nemeses.expedition_modifiers['5']).

upgraded_basic_replacement._about: Number of basic nemesis cards replaced with upgraded basic cards in each tier.

nemesis_setup_per_battle.solo_cap: In solo, never add more upgraded basic cards than the number of basic cards you would normally use (1 / 3 / 7).
nemesis_setup_per_battle.increased_difficulty_overrides: Increased Difficulty rules override Expedition rules.

nemesis_deck.order: Shuffle each tier separately; stack tier 3 at the bottom, tier 2 on top of it, tier 1 on top. Never shuffle the deck afterwards.
nemesis_deck.tier_0: Tier 0 cards are setup/special cards used as the nemesis mat instructs.
nemesis_deck.mixing_boxes: Basic cards from any release may be mixed, but this can make the game harder.

setup: Choose one friend and one foe and place their mats.
Shuffle each 4-card attack deck facedown; reveal the top card and leave it faceup.
Add one turn order card for the friend and one for the foe.
Draw (players + 2) banner cards; each player chooses one for their starting hand and destroys a card of the same type from their hand (any card if unable). Return the rest.
Follow any setup on the back of their mats.
friends_and_foes.difficulty: Friend only = easier, foe only = harder.
friends_and_foes.in_expedition: Intentionally left open: random via randomizers, or pick to help; intended to be a different friend and foe each game.
friends_and_foes.gameplay: On their turn order card, resolve the top card of their deck. They have no life and cannot be damaged. Abilities trigger as soon as they have enough charges.

xaxos_outcast.rules: Players may give charges they would gain to Xaxos: Outcast. At 8 charges he loses all charges and resolves a random card from his ability deck. Effects on Gravehold refer to him. He is not a player.
xaxos_outcast.supply_note: Do not use supply cards that interact with Xaxos: Outcast unless playing with the module.

win.add_to_barracks: Draw one gem, one relic and one spell randomizer and add those cards to the Barracks.

lose.add_to_barracks: Add one card of your choice of source: a player card randomizer, a treasure deck you have already drawn from, or a random mage.
lose.then: Fight the same nemesis again, or start a new expedition.

scoring.total: Sum over all battles once the final battle is won.

variants.name: Short Expedition
variants.rules: Skip Battle 1: draw the level 1 treasures as if Battle 1 were won, then start at Battle 2.

variants.name: Extended Expedition
variants.rules: Draw player card randomizers after every battle; draw treasures only after even battles (L1 after 2, L2 after 4, L3 after 6, L4 after 8). Nemesis decks: battles 1-2 from Battle 1, 3-4 from Battle 2, 5-6 from Battle 3, 7-8 from Battle 4, 9-10 from Battle 5.

variants.name: Big Pockets
variants.rules: Unused player cards return to the Barracks instead of being banished.

turn_order_deck.solo_note: A true solo game uses 4 player cards and 2 nemesis cards; any player card means the solo mage.

content_exclusions._about: Content that cannot be used in Expedition mode, from the End of Campaign booklets and the wiki's No Randomizer category.

mages.title: Legacy Mage
mages.reason: player-built Legacy character; usable if you own one (equipment optional)

nemesis_cards.reason: campaign versions are replaced by Stop END deck cards outside the campaign

nemesis_cards.title: Bladius Attacks
nemesis_cards.reason: do not use when playing Bladius outside the campaign

nemesis_cards.title: Grasp
nemesis_cards.reason: replaced by L2-END-019 (Voracious Spell Fetter) for Griefweaver

player_cards.rule: Legacy of Gravehold boost / overheat cards
player_cards.reason: not recommended outside the campaign (randomizers exist anyway)

player_cards.rule: cards that interact with Xaxos: Outcast
player_cards.reason: only with the Xaxos: Outcast module

basic_cards.rule: Legacy: use the Stop END deck basics (END55-END76), not the Evolve campaign basics
Legacy of Gravehold: use the basics of either the Bishop of Scrolls (L2-BS) or Fate Shepherd (L2-FS) deck, not both; replace Devil's Pact and Divide with L2-END-025/026

legacy_power.note: Legacy player card power by card-number prefix.
